flat_block.recursion: P_(n+1)=P_n+z^(v_n)Q_n and Q_(n+1)=P_n-z^(v_n)Q_n, with v_n doubling one rectangular support side and the axes cycled.
flat_block.support: Disjoint support gives d_n=2^n coefficients in {+1,-1}; at n=3r the support is a complete 2^r by 2^r by 2^r frequency cube.
flat_block.fourth_recurrence: For T_n=int(|P_n|^4+|Q_n|^4), the separated shift kills the doubled cross frequency and T_(n+1)=16d_n^2-2T_n.
flat_block.selected_flatness: At least one R_n in {P_n,Q_n} obeys int|R_n|^4/d_n^2<=4/3-(1/3)(-1/2)^n<=3/2 for n>=1.
flat_block.shell_transfer: A monomial frequency translation moves the complete cube into a fixed-ratio cutoff shell without changing any L2 or L4 identity.
